theorem typeI1_first {α δ T : ℝ} {a : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (hT : 6e6 ≤ T)
    (h : Approx2 α (T ^ 3) δ a q (3 / 4 * T ^ 2)) (hqT : (q : ℝ) ≤ T / 6) :
    ‖typeILog α (T ^ 3) (U1 T (delta0 δ * q))‖ ≤
      3.8 * (2 * T ^ 3 / (delta0 δ * Nat.totient q)) +
        (Real.log (delta0 δ * q) + 2.96) * (2 * T ^ 3 / (delta0 δ * q)) + 0.014 * (T ^ 2 * √T) :=

note: The printed c_{10,I} term is overstated by √(qδ₀): U²/(4qx) = x^{1/3}/(324q²δ₀). Erratum: (6.53) prints the all-n main term (x/q)min(1,c_0'/delta^2) with Mobius sums over (m,q)=1, but S_{I,1} sums over odd m and odd n, whose main term is (x/2q)|eta^(-delta/2)S_log+(log eta)^(-delta/2)S_1| with sums over (m,2q)=1 (checked by `scripts/checks/eq_6_53.py`).
